title: Proper Maintenance of Perimeter Areas Accessible by Public
what_it_is: Proper Maintenance of Perimeter Areas Accessible by Public

sections.label: Maintenance of commercial premises areas
sections.summary: Landowners are responsible for maintaining commercial premises and surrounding areas, and agencies can enforce action for public safety.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for National Development what can be done to owners/lessees of commercial premises/land who fail to properly maintain their perimeter/surrounding areas including footpaths and roads which the public and pedestrians have access to.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: So, we are very clear it is the responsibility of these landowners.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: For specific cases where public safety is concerned, Government agencies can and will carry out enforcement action against the private owner.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Building and Construction Authority (BCA) may issue Notices to Maintain under the Building Maintenance and Strata Management Act if commercial buildings and their surrounding structures are not properly maintained in a serviceable condition.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Under the Street Works Act, LTA may also require private footpaths and roads that are in a dangerous or defective condition to be rectified.
